visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens with a man in a vibrant red suit and a pink towel on his head blowing a yellow whistle. He stands in front of a traditional temple with a crowd of people in the background. (2) A large man wearing a red and blue striped sweater runs through a grassy park toward the camera. (3) Vibrant graphic overlays appear featuring the game 'Arena of Valor' logo and Chinese New Year themes. (4) Back at the temple, the large man interacts with the host in the red suit. The crowd claps and cheers. (5) Close-up shots show the men engaged in a comical dialogue. (6) The large man attempts to jump over hurdles but fails, falling onto a green mat. (7) Small, stylized animated female characters appear on the man's shoulder to encourage him. (8) The man tries the jump again, successfully clearing the hurdles while the crowd erupts in applause. (9) The video transitions to a game interface showcasing various character skins and promotional items for the Lunar New Year event.
